summary: dellemc.powerflex device, info, protection_domain, snapshot, storagepool and volume modules are Gen1-only and replaced by v2 modules on Gen2; fault_set, replication and resource_group and sds modules aren't supported on Gen2.
questions: Do the dellemc.powerflex volume modules work on PowerFlex Gen2?
Which powerflex modules are unsupported on Gen2?

answer_card.title: PowerFlex Gen1 vs Gen2 modules
answer_card.answer_md:
- `device`, `info`, `protection_domain`, `snapshot`, `storagepool` and `volume` work only on **PowerFlex Gen1**; use the **v2 modules** on Gen2.
- `fault_set`, `replication_consistency_group`, `replication_pair`, `resource_group` and `sds` are **not supported on Gen2**.
